Kristen Wiig
Kristen Carroll Wiig ( ; born August 22, 1973) is an American actress, comedian, writer, and producer. She is known for her work on the NBC sketch comedy series "Saturday Night Live" (2005–12), and such films as "Bridesmaids", "The Martian", and "Ghostbusters".

Vladimir Danilevich
Vladimir Petrovich Danilevich (Russian: Владимир Петрович Данилевич ; 4 September 1924 — 9 October 2001) was well-known Soviet and Russian Animator: who successfully worked as the film director, the screenwriter, the art director and the animator.
